Criteria:
Growth, equally divided between:
• Income Distance (after per capita income of high income
districts is deflated to double of average per capita income of
rest of the State)
• Capital Expenditure

Fiscal Efficiency and Discipline, equally divided between:
• Resource Mobilisation
• Adoption of Public Financial Management System (PFMS)
and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

Population, equally divided across:
• Rural–urban ratio
• Improvement in sex ratio
• Younger demographic profile

Area, equally divided across:
• Forest cover
• Cropped area
• Irrigated area

Contribution to National Priorities, equally divided across:
• Contribution to central pool of food grains
• Armed Forces
• Sports
